projects.name: Texas Panhandle site
projects.quote: Last month, we announced a new site in the Texas Panhandle with 205 megawatts of immediately available, low-cost, long- term power.

projects.name: Salt Creek
projects.quote: Restructuring and optimization initiatives, together with the energization of Salt Creek, enabled a 21% reduction in our energy cost per kilowatt-hour from $0.040 in Q1 2024 to $0.032 in Q2 2024.

projects.name: King Mountain JV
projects.quote: Energy capacity under management (mining) includes 180 MW of self-mining site capacity comprising Alpha, Medicine Hat, and Salt (5) Creek, as well as 280 MW of capacity under management at the King Mountain JV.
